Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the final session! The Bangladesh players make their way out in the middle. Followed by the Zimbabwe openers - Milton Shumba and Takudzwanashe Kaitano. Taskin Ahmed to start with the ball.

Right then! The bowlers are done for the day and now the responsibility lies in the hands of the Zimbabwe batters. They have a mountain to climb in front of them. Zimbabwe will just try not to lose too many wickets early. They will need a strong partnership to get going. On the other hand, Bangladesh will be looking to snatch a few wickets early. Join us in a bit for Zimbabwe's reply.

Another session which went in the favor of Bangladesh. From 294 for 8 at one stage, Mahmudullah and Taskin Ahmed joined forces to build an amazing partnership of 191 runs. That partnership is the highest 9th wicket partnership for Bangladesh in Test cricket. Mahmudullah played exceedingly well. He did not give anything away and fought out till the end. He was very well supported by his partner in crime - Taskin Ahmed. He too batted well and brought up his maiden Test fifty. Zimbabwe will be blaming themselves for bowling way too many no balls and extras. They missed out on an opportunity much earlier into the game when Taskin Ahmed edged the ball at the second slip but Milton Shumba made a mess out of it. They got another golden run-out opportunity which would have been sure short curtains for Taskin Ahmed but it was just not meant to be. Blessing Muzarabani was the pick of the bowlers ending with 4 wickets to his name. Victor Nyauchi and Donald Tiripano are the other two bowlers with 2 wickets each. Overall, a rather poor bowling display from the hosts.

Hello and welcome to Day 2 of the only Test between Zimbabwe and Bangladesh. On Day 1, Zimbabwe started brilliantly by getting a wicket in the first over itself, courtesy to their standout bowler Blessing Muzarabani. The wickets kept tumbling after that and were 132 for 6 at one stage but then Liton Das and Mahmudullah joined forces to drag the team out of some serious peril and stitched an amazing 138 run partnership. Zimbabwe found a dose of adrenaline after long toil when Liton Das fell to Donald Tiripano just 5 runs short of his maiden century. Mahmudullah who brought up his 17th half-century is still at the crease with Taskin Ahmed and they would like to add as many runs as possible before folding up. Meanwhile, Zimbabwe would look to finish things early and walk out to bat. What will happen? Stay with us to find out.

Earlier in the day, after being asked to bowl first, Zimbabwe had a dream start as Blessing Muzarabani took two wickets in the first hour itself. Mominul Haque and Shadman Islam put on a gritty stand to take their team out of the spot of bother. But Shadman Islam fell just before Lunch. Post Lunch, the Zimbabwe bowlers wreaked havoc. Blessing Muzarabani took one wicket and Victor Nyauchi took two as they sent back Mushfiqur Rahim, Shakib Al Hasan and Mominul Haque in quick succession. They would have wanted to skittle off the lower order in no time, but Liton Das and Mahmudullah brought all their experience into play to avoid that.

A patient and gritty partnership by Liton Das and Mahmudullah led the recovery for Bangladesh. They were 132 for 6 but these two added 138 runs to take their side to a safer score. Das would have wanted to score a ton but was out for 95. Mahmudullah got to his 50 and would want to add a few more quick runs on Day 2. In comparison to their bowling in the first two sessions, Zimbabwe had a tougher time with the ball in the last session. They relied on Milton Shumba to do the bulk of the bowling but the left-armer posed no threat to the batters. Things were looking bleak for them, but Donald Tiripano took two wickets on successive deliveries to bring things in balance. They took the second new ball late in the day but bad light cut things short. Now, it is crucial for them to use the new ball well early on Day 2 to wrap things up.

This is the second session of the day, that has gone the way of the hosts. They started the session off in fine manner as in a matter of 5 minutes, they removed two batters, courtesy Blessing Muzarabani and then, Victor Nyauchi, as they removed Rahim and Shakib in no time. The skipper of Bangladesh, Haque, who also reached his fifty, was not really finding his rhythm, as he kept nicking a couple of balls, but the catch was the only thing missing. Just before the drinks break, that changed too, as the man at gully ended Haque's innings and the visitors were in some trouble. After that, Mahmudullah and Das have stitched a stand, which is at 35 right now, and have steading things slightly, but they know that they will have to go on longer. Will they be able to bat out the day? Or will Zimbabwe bundle the visitors out and cut that lead on stumps today? Join us for the third session shortly.

Pushed to the man at mid off.
Outside off, on a length, Liton blocks it well.
An eventful over comes to a close. On off, pushed to covers.
Slightly behind the good length, outside off, Haque again looks to leave this alone but raises his blade a tad too late. The ball takes the bottom edge and goes to the keeper on the bounce.
Around off, length ball, pushed to the cover region.
Outside off, left alone.

DROPPED! This time, the man in form, Blessing Muzarabani makes a meal of this. Should have been taken and the skipper had to head back. On a length, around off, Haque looks to push but only manages to check his shot back towards the bowler. Blessing Muzarabani moves to his right and gets his hand to this, but fails to hold on. A lifeline for the Bangladesh captain!
On a shortish length, outside off, an easy leave by MH.

FOUR! If there is width on offer, then Das is not going to hold himself back. Another instance where there is some space outside off, on a length, and Das leans ahead and pushes this through extra cover.
On a fuller length around off, Liton smothers the ball out.
Short of a length around off, Liton blocks well.
FOUR! The first boudary of the bat off Das! On a length outside off, this is driven with ease through extra cover for a boundary.
Good length on off, pushed gently to the left of the man at mid on.
A short of a length ball, around off, Das blocks it via the upper part of the blade.

FOUR! The placement and timing were key for the ball to reach the ropes here. On a fuller length, width offered outside off, Haque leans into the shot and strokes it past the man at covers for a boundary.
On a shortish length, around off, MH hops and awkwardly keeps this one out.
On a length and around off, Haque works this one to the cover region.
A length ball way outside off. MH shoulders arms.
Around off and middle, glanced to the leg side.
A back of a length ball, around off, slanting away, Haque looks to leave it but the extra bounce takes the bottom part of the bat and goes to the keeper on the bounce.
Fires a full one, on the pads. Das tucks it towards square leg.
Fuller ball, on off. Das defends it out.
Good length ball, outside off. Left alone now.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Finally, an edge induced by Victor Nyauchi is taken! Serves a wide length ball. Shakib Al Hasan strangely decides to chase this one early on in his innings. The ball takes the outside edge and Regis Chakabva takes it with ease. That is the second wicket in two overs and Zimbabwe are well and truly on top here!
Commentary.Howout: c Regis Chakabva b Victor Nyauchi

Commentary.Commentary: Half the Bangladeshi side back in the hut and Liton Das strides out.
Serves a length ball, outside off. Punched towards covers.
Fuller ball, on off. Defended out.
Wide of the fielder! Fuller ball, outside off. Hasan is early in the stroke and ends up chipping it wide of silly mid off. They take three as the fielder chases it down.
Back of a length, outside off. Pushed to covers.

OUT! LBW! Beautiful bowling by Blessing Muzarabani! The previous ball went away and this one came back in! This lands on a length, outside off, and jags back in. Rahim shoulders his arms but gets hit on the pads. The umpire raises his finger to send him back and Blessing is on the moon, he is enjoying his time out there. The leave has cost him his wicket. Rahim doesn't look happy with the decision. Maybe, because he was hit high on the pads. Either way, off he goes!
Out comes Shakib Al Hasan!
Blessing Muzarabani tempts Mushfiqur Rahim by pitching it up, outside off. But Rahim chooses to let the keeper to collect this.
Fires a full one, on off. Clipped to the leg side now.
Good length ball, on the fifth stump line. Rahim gets to the pitch of the ball but then leaves it.
Back of a length, outside off. Haque pushes it past gully for a couple.
Shorter ball, outside off. Haque misses his cut.
Low full toss, on off. Haque pushes it to mid on.
Back of a length, outside off. Left alone.
Full on middle, worked to mid on.
NO BALL. Fuller ball, outside off. Clipped towards square leg for one. Another no ball, as Victor had overstepped.
Fuller ball, outside off. Clipped towards square leg for one.

PUT DOWN! Oh dear, how costly will this be? The ball on the pads almost gets the wicket here. Mominul Haque looks to flick it away but gets the leading edge. Richard Ngarava is standing at mid on, but he is slow to react to it. He dives forward in the end, but the ball falls well short. Two runs are taken.
Fuller ball, on off. Defended out.

FOUR! 50 for Mominul Haque! He has looked so good out there, in sharp contrast to his other teammates. Now, he will look to put on a big score. Length ball, on the pads. Haque whips it to the mid-wicket fence. That also brings the 100 up for Bangladesh.
Comes over the wicket and hurls a length ball, on off. Pushed to the off side.
FOUR! You simply cannot bowl to this man on the pads! Angling down the leg side. Mominul Haque runs it down to the fine leg fence. Moves to 48 now.
Bowls it very full outside off. Defended out.
Good length ball, on the fourth stump line. Defended off the back foot.

FOUR! Another edge that runs to the fence! Length ball, around off. Rahim looks to play it to the off side but gets the outside edge. But because he played it with soft hands, the ball lands in front of the slip cordon and runs to the fence.
Closer to the off pole now. Rahim taps it to the off side.
Fuller ball, outside off. Rahim strides forward and pushes it to point.
On the pads now. Haque works it towards square leg for one.
Shorter ball, outside off. Left alone.
NO BALL AND FOUR! Mominul Haque keeps getting the boundaries in that region! Fuller ball, outside off. He takes a step down the track and clips it wide of mid on for a boundary.
Just short of the fielder! Back of a length, around off. Rahim looks to defend it from the crease but gets the outside edge. The ball drops just short of the third slip.
FOUR! Edged and four yet again! Blessing Muzarabani draws Rahim into the drive but all that he manages is an outside edge. The ball goes past gully and runs to the fence.
Fuller ball, on the pads. Rahim gets the leading edge as he looks to work it to the leg side. The ball goes towards gully.
Serves a length ball, just outside off. Left alone by Rahim.
Back of a length, outside off. Pushed to covers now.
Length ball, outside off. Rahim is beaten as he looks to defend.
FOUR! Such a pleasing stroke! Victor Nyauchi misses his line yet again and bowls it on the pads. Mominul Haque nicely whips it to the left of mid on for a boundary.
Who will bowl from the other end? Blessing Muzarabani, it is. 5-2-5-2 so far.
On the pads again. Rahim works it to the right of mid on for one.
Full ball, on the pads. Haque clips it towards mid-wicket for one.
Fuller ball, on off. Defended out.
In the airrrr...but safe! Shorter ball, outside off. Haque gets the top edge over the slips. Brendan Taylor chases it down and dives. Two runs are taken.
Starts with a length ball, outside off. Haque leaves it alone.
We are back for the second session of play. Mominul Haque and Mushfiqur Rahim make their way out now. Victor Nyauchi will begin the second session with the ball.
... Day 1, Session 2 ...

Bangladesh had a horrid start at the start as they lost Saif Hassan and Najmul Hossain Shanto for timid scores. But their skipper, Mominul Haque and Shadman Islam batted with intent to bring them out from a spot of bother. Haque looked in great touch since the very first ball, while Shadman Islam struggled at first to get runs but looked much better as he spent more time on the crease. He would have wanted to bat till Lunch till the very least but fell towards the fag end of the session. They would want Mushfiqur Rahim to build a strong stand with his skipper. Do join us for the second session. It promises to be testing one for the batters as Blessing Muzarabani is expected to come back in the attack. Do join us for that and we will be back in a while!

Zimbabwe bowling was all about Blessing Muzarabani at the start. The tall pacer bowled in the right channels in the morning and got the ball to swing in both directions. He was rightfully rewarded with two wickets early on. But apart from him, all the pacers struggled quite a bit, they got past the outside edge and even got the edge on occasions but failed to bowl consistently in the right channels for an extended duration. There were also a handful of no balls in their bowling. Richard Ngarava struck just before Lunch to tilt things in their favor. They will look to pick a few quick wickets post Lunch.
On a length around off, nudged to the on side. THAT WILL BE LUNCH ON DAY 1!
The physio is out there to check on Mushfiqur Rahim's finger as there is a bit of blood oozing out from the right index finger.
On a shortish length, around off, the ball shoots up after hitting the deck as Rahim looks to defend and the ball rises and hits Rahim on his finger.
Slanting across the right-hander, on a length, Mushfiqur has no qualms in letting this one go.
Wider, fuller, outside off, Rahim makes no attempt to play at this.
The batsman has just blocked that from his crease.
Digs in a short ball on middle, ducked under by Rahim. The visitors will be looking to see out the next couple of overs, before Lunch.
Back of a length ball, on off, tapped to point.
On a fuller length on middle, worked through short fine leg and the strike is exchanged.
Angled into middle, MR blocks it softly to the leg side.
Sticks with the wider and fuller ball outside off, Rahim makes no effort to go fishing after this.
Wider and fuller outside off, Haque guides this one through cover-point and rotates the strike.
Back of a length around off, Haque defends it out well.
A wicket-maiden for Richard Ngarava! A length ball, outside off, Rahim takes a step ahead and shoulders arms.
Around off, on a length, MR again pushes this to the off side.
A back of a length ball, around off. Rahim blocks it out to the off side.
Around off, defended.
Outside off, Rahim wants nothing to do with this early on. Left alone.
Mushfiqur Rahim walks out to bat now.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Just when things were looking bright for the visitors, they lose another one. Ngarava strikes and the third one falls. This was a very good delivery and this stand, which was taking the Tigers to safer shores, has been broken. A length ball, around the off pole, it nips away late as Shadman Islam looks to have a poke at this tentatively. The outside edge is generated and the Zimbabwean skipper, Brendan Taylor, at first slip, makes no mistake.
Commentary.Howout: c Brendan Taylor b Richard Ngarava

Commentary.Commentary: Maiden over! Outside off, slightly behind the good length, Haque raises his blade and allows it through.
Closer to off, length, pushed to the cover region.
On off, blocked.
Angles a length ball across the southpaw, left easily by the skipper.
A touch fuller, on off. MH defends.
A touch fuller around off, MH pushes it back to the bowler.
Another leave as this is bowled in the channel outside the off pole.
On a length outside off, Islam makes no effort to play at this.
Around off, pushed to the mid off region.
On middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
An appeal for LBW but there seemed to be two noises there. A length ball, around off, MH looks to fend it out but the ball takes the inside edge and hits the pad.
On a length outside off, Haque leaves it be.
Sprays one wide outside off. Left alone.
A touch wider now and this is left alone with ease.
Well bowled. Bowls it on a length, just outside off. Shadman Islam is beaten as he looks to defend.
Back of a length, outside off. Left alone now.
Fuller ball, outside off. Punched to covers now.
Serves a length ball, around off. Shadman defends it out.
Serves a fuller ball, on off. Haque leans into it and punches it to mid off.
Back of a length, outside off. Mominul Haque leaves it alone.
Fuller ball, down the leg side. Haque misses his flick.
FOUR! Deft touch! Shorter ball, outside off. Mominul Haque opens the face of the bat and runs it past gully for a boundary.
Back of a length, on off. Mominul Haque defends it out.
Fires a full one, down the leg side. Haque misses his flick.
Richard Ngarava (4-1-11-0) is back on.
Full and wide enough for Shadman Islam to leave it.
Serves a length ball, just outside off. Left alone by Shadman Islam.
Shorter ball, outside off. Shadman Islam gets the under edge back on the deck as he looks to play it through covers.
FOUR! Gorgeous stroke! Fuller ball, outside off. Shadman Islam leans into it and punches it past mid off for a boundary.
Good length ball, outside off. Left alone.
FOUR! Uppish and safe! Full and way outside off. Shadman Islam throws the bat at it, the ball goes uppishly but wide of point and runs to the fence. That is also the 50-run stand between these two.
Back of a length, outside off. Left alone.
Nicely played. Shorter ball, outside off. Shadman Islam punches it past point. The fielder chases it but they still get three.
Fuller ball, on off. Defended out.

FOUR! Victor Nyauchi is frustrated that this edge goes to the ropes! Back of a length, outside off. Shadman Islam looks to defend but gets the outside edge. The ball goes past the third slip and runs to the fence. 50 up for Bangladesh.
Beaten! Length ball, just outside off. Shadman Islam is beaten as he looks to defend.
Quick run. Back of a length, outside off. Mominul Haque taps it just past the stumps at the other end. There is a bit of confusion but they scamper through for one.
Lets it go on a length, outside off. Nicely defended off the front foot by Shadman Islam.
Great work by Dion Myers! Short and wide outside off. Shadman Islam cuts it away but Myers dives at covers to stop a certain boundary.
Serves a length ball, just outside off. Shadman Islam plays it towards cover.
Over the wicket now. Outside off and Shadman Islam blocks it out.
Full ball, outside off. Haque nicely pushes it past the diving cover fielder for one. No ball called as Donald Tiripano has overtstepped.
Fuller ball, on off. Mominul Haque is solid in his defence.
FOUR! Do not bowl on his pads! Donald Tiripano comes 'round the stumps and bowls a full one, on the pads. Haque sends the ball to the square leg fence with ease.
A slight halt in play as Regis Chakabva is getting tape put on one of his fingers.
FOUR! Edged and four! Good length ball, outside off. Shadman Islam tries to defend it from the crease but gets the outside edge. The ball goes past the second slip and runs to the fence.
Well left by Shadman Islam as this is wider outside off.
Beaten! Lets it go on a length, just outside off. Shadman Islam is forced to attempt a defensive stroke but is beaten.
Serves a length ball, just outside off. Shadman Islam strides forward to defend it.
Back of a length, outside off. Left alone by Shadman Islam.
Back of a length, around middle and leg. Defended out.
FOUR! Lovely stroke! Full ball, on the pads. Mominul Haque uses his wrist and sends the ball to the mid-wicket fence.
Lets it go on a length, on off. Haque plays it towards mid on now.
A touch fuller, outside off. Pushed towards mid off now.
Bowls a length ball, on the fifth stump line. Haque covers the line of the ball and lets it go.
A touch shorter but wide enough for Haque to leave it.
Fuller ball, wide outside off. Mominul Haque watches the keeper collect this one.
Serves a fuller ball, just outside off. Pushed to covers now.

DRINKS. This is just the first hour that the hosts would have wanted. It seems that Blessing Muzarabani just keeps getting blessings from the lords above as he is just getting better and better. He is the leader of the Zimbabwean pace attack, and he has already snaffled two wickets so far. For the visitors, Haque and Islam have steadied the ship, slightly, but they know that they will have to continue and will be hoping to stay unbeaten until the Lunch break.
Good length ball, wider outside off. Shadman Islam leaves it.
Nicely played! Shorter ball, outside off. Haque rises with the bounces and punches it through covers. The fielder chases it down and they get three.
Fuller ball, outside off. Left alone.
FOUR! Classy shot! Another one on the pads. Mominul Haque clips it to the mid-wicket fence.
Fuller ball, on the pads. Clipped towards mid on now.
Changes from both ends, then. Victor Nyauchi is introduced into the attack.
Good length on off, kept out.
NO BALL. Yet again. Slightly poor from Donald and Zimbabwe, in general, as Tiripano steps out again. Around off, kept out.
Fuller, but wider outside off. Islam shoulders arms.
On middle, watchfully kept out.
NO BALL. Quite a lot of loose deliveries as Donald oversteps on this occasion. A length ball, on middle, nudged to the leg side for a single.
Around off, defended out.
Still finding his radar here, is Donald! Down the leg side yet again, MH looks for the tuck away but fails to connect with hisshot.
Down the leg side, Haque looks to flick but misses.
First change of the Test! Donald Tiripano comes in the attack.
That is defended solidly off the front foot.
Played it well and late. Around off, on a length, this is gently pushed through covers at the eleventh hour by Islam and they come back for the second run too.
On a length in the fourth stump channel, well left by Islam.
Around off, blocked.
Around off, SI taps this to the cover region and looks for one, but it sent back by Mominul.
The batsman has just blocked that from his crease.
Ends the over with a spicy bouncer around off, MH sways away and lets it pass.
Length around off, defended out.
FOUR! That is a good shot by the skipper. A little too striaght from Richard Ngarava and bowls it on a length. MH whips this one easily through mid-wicket and finds the fence.
Around off, zipping in, Mominul Haque leaves it late and Regis Chakabva moves to his right and collects the ball cleanly.
Around off, defended watchfully.
NO BALL. Richard oversteps yet again. On a length, on middle and leg, Haque misses his flick and the ball takes the pad and rolls to the leg side, as the batters take two leg byes.
A slight halt in play as there is some issue with the boundary ropes near the sight screen.

FOUR! Clipped away. Much needed boundary for the Tigers, as they have found it hard to score the runs so far. A length ball, on middle and leg, whipped away gently fine on the leg side for a boundary.
Again, wider and outside off, no issues in leaving this one alone.
Outside off, no shot offered.
Fuller, outside off. MH leaves but the keeper fumbles as well, and the batters pounce and steal a run.

Could have been run out and that is the last thing that Bangladesh need right now. Around middle, dropped to the leg side. Haque comes ahead, wants the run, but sends his partner back. Islam scampers back into his crease, as the throw comes in, but it is missed.
Slants a length ball across the southpaw, the skipper of the visiting side wants nothing to do with this. Leaves it.
Full on off, pushed gently to the cover region.
On a length around off, this is dropped back onto the deck. Another testing over comes to a close.
Very full on leg again, no room to work with, Islam pokes this one to the leg side.
A back of a length ball, down the leg side, Islam moves inside the line and looks to flick but misses. The keeper does well to move across and stop the ball.
Pitches it up and around middle and leg, this is dug out to the on side.
Hurls a low full toss on off, this is pushed back gently to the bowler.
On a fuller length, around off, dug out to the off side.
NO BALL. This is a great delivery but Richard had overstepped. On a length, outside off, the away movement comes into play again. Shadman Islam leaves it, albeit late.
Well left again. This is closer to the off pole, but Haque strides forward and then leaves it.
Length ball, on the fifth stump line. Haque plants his foot forward and then leaves it. Well left.
Another shorter ball. Wide enough for Haque to leave it.
Back of a length, outside off. Left alone.

OUT! TAKEN! Blessing Muzarabani is breathing fire out there! This is a typical Day 1 first session wicket for him. Hurls a length ball, just outside off. Shanto is half a stride into it and gets the outside edge, as the angle works out against him. Dion Myers, the debutant, takes it with ease at the third slip and the visitors are slipping within the first 30 minutes of the Test!
Commentary.Howout: c Dion Myers b Blessing Muzarabani

Commentary.Commentary: The skipper of the Bangladesh team, Mominul Haque is into the middle now.
Tap and run. Back of a length, outside off. Shadman Islam taps it towards covers for a quick single.
A very solid front foot push past covers for one now. Shadman Islam got a good stride in to play this.
Fires a full one, down the leg side. Regis Chakabva dives full length to his right and makes half a stop.
A touch fuller now, on the off pole. Pushed away towards point.
Back of a length, wider outside off. This is left alone with ease.
Beaten! Length ball, just outside off. Shadman Islam gets half a stride forward but is beaten on the defence.
Fuller ball, on off. Pushed to point now.
Beaten again! This is excellent bowling by Blessing Muzarabani. Length ball, just outside off. Shanto is beaten as he looks to defend it.
First runs off the bat! Fuller ball, on off. Shanto punches it past mid on for a couple now.
A pacy shorter ball, outside off. Shanto leaves it alone.

The physio is out in the middle. Najmul Hossain Shanto got hit around his thigh and went down, looking to be in discomfort. Probably around the box, which can be a TAD bit uncomfortable. Looks to be okay to continue though as he takes his guard...
Well bowled. This lands on middle and jags back in. There is a bit of extra bounce and Shanto gets hit on the thigh as he looks to defend.
Beaten! Length ball, angling across the left-hander. Shanto looks to defend it but the ball zips past the outside edge.
A touch shorter this time, on off. Shanto defends it from the crease.
Bowls a yorker length ball, on off. Defended out now. A maiden for Richard Ngarava.
Beaten! This comes back in after landing outside off. Shadman Islam is beaten as he looks to defend it from the crease.
Right in the channel outside off. Bit of away movement from the left-armer but Shadman is not interested in playing.
Serves a fuller ball, around off. Shadman defends it off the front foot.
Much better now. Pitched up, just outside off. Shadman shoulders arms to it.
Starts with a shorter ball, outside off. Left alone now.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Richard Ngarava! 3 slips and a gully for Ngarava...
Length ball, down the leg side. Shanto misses his flick. A wicket in the first over for Zimbabwe!

OUT! BOWLED! What a start for Blessing Muzarabani! That's a top, top delivery to send back one of the Bangla openers! Hits the deck on a length, just outside off. The ball comes in with the angle. Saif Hassan looks to defend it from the crease but the ball goes past the outside edge and rattles the stumps. A duck for Hassan and a dream start for the hosts.
Najmul Hossain Shanto makes his way out into the middle.
Serves a length ball, just outside off. Hassan leaves it alone.
Back of a length, outside off. Left alone.
FOUR BYES! First runs of the Test! Length ball, down the leg side. Hassan misses his flick. The keeper fails to grab it and the ball runs to the fence.
A bumper to start! Blessing Muzarabani digs this short, on the body. Saif Hassan gets hit on the body as he looks to duck under it.

Right then. The Zimbabwe players make their way out into the middle, followed by the openers for Bangladesh, who are Saif Hassan and Shadman Islam. As expected, Blessing Muzarabani will open the bowling for the hosts. Here he comes...

WEATHER - The weather is not going to be too hot or humid and it expected to be chilly at the start of the day's play, with it getting slightly warmer as the game goes on. No rain is expected to visit on all the 5 days.
The teams have lined up for the National Anthems. First, the Bangladeshi anthem will be played, followed by the Zimbabwe anthem.

Brendan Taylor, the Zimbabwe skipper, says that they would have bowled first so they are happy with the toss. Says that traditionally Harare has some help for the bowlers early on. Adds that they are up against a very experienced side but they are looking forward to it. Further adds that the team is fortunate to have some cricket at this point. Finishes by saying that Kaitano and Myers will make their debut.

The Bangladesh skipper, Mominul Haque says that the deck looks dry and the last innings will be crucial and there will be some spin on offer there. Feels that the preparations have been good so far. States that they are going to play 4 bowlers and 7 batters.

PITCH REPORT - Tino Mawoyo says that it is a cold morning and thinks that the sun will come out as the game goes on. Says that there is some grass cover and there are some bare patches as well and there are some cracks on this deck. Thinks that the spinners could get some purchase here. Expects some bounce and carry on Day 1 and it will be interesting to see how the game pans out.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Takudzwanashe Kaitano, Milton Shumba, Brendan Taylor (C), Dion Myers, Timycen Maruma, Roy Kaia, Regis Chakabva (WK), Donald Tiripano, Victor Nyauchi, Blessing Muzarabani, Richard Ngarava.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Shadman Islam, Saif Hassan, Mominul Haque (C), Najmul Hossain Shanto, Mushfiqur Rahim, Shakib Al Hasan, Mahmudullah, Liton Das (WK), Mehidy Hasan, Taskin Ahmed, Ebadot Hossain.
TOSS- Bangladesh have won the toss and will bat first.

Hello and a very warm welcome to one and all for this one-off Test between Zimbabwe and Bangladesh. Both these teams are going to be locking horns in all the 3 formats and will be starting off with a solitary Test. It seems pretty evenly matched and could be anyone's game but with the deck supposed to be on the slower side, the Bangladeshi spinners will look to reap rewards, but ruling out the pace attack of the Zimbabweans would be a mistake on our part. The bowling seems alright for both the teams, but the batting of the hosts could be an issue which the Tigers could exploit. It will be interesting to see how these two fare. Toss and team news up in a bit.
